title: 第23章 甜羹的回忆第24章 惹谁也别招惹齐煜
slug: 重生后为当他的皇后杀疯了
content_zh:
走着走着，集市上一阵嘹亮的吆喝声，将樱落拉入了过往的思绪中。
“卖甜羹喽，卖甜羹喽，刚熬好出炉的甜羹……”
樱落耳朵尖离着老远，就听见卖甜羹的老伯正在吆喝。
前世的樱落最喜爱这甜羹。
每次皇上都会便装陪她来民间集市上游玩，买来甜羹，哄樱落开心。
可如今已经物是人非，现在的齐瀚已不似当年的那人，不再记得这些……
樱落眼眸低垂，心里有些失落。
不过，她很快就平复了心情，拉着身边两位有些“格格不入”的男人。
“哎哎，那边有卖甜羹的。走，两位公子，咱们也去买几碗尝尝嘛，肯定很甜很好喝。”
“你怎么知道，这个肯定好喝？”齐煜习惯性的反驳道。
樱落却不同他计较，只是自顾自的往前走。
“公子不懂，一般这种街边的小铺可比寻常店里的口味更好，用料也足。走嘛，过去瞧瞧，反正咱们也是出来闲逛的，不如尝尝这民间百姓们吃的东西，难道二位公子说的体察民情，都是哄人的吗？”
齐瀚哈哈一笑，“当然不是，樱儿巧舌如簧，这些说得都有道理。我们既然是来体察民情的，不如就闲逛看看去。”
于是，两个人跟着樱落欢快的步伐，几步就窜到了那位老伯伯的摊位前。
樱落主动凑上前去，“老伯伯，麻烦给我来三碗甜羹！”
老伯伯和蔼的笑着说：“好嘞！只要五文钱，看你们这么多人喝，伯伯我再送你一份水果，怎么样啊？”
“好，那谢谢伯伯了！”
樱落甜甜的笑着感谢。
说完，老伯伯抬手给了樱落一个托盘，上面盛满了三碗甜羹，又依次摆上了水果。
樱落端起托盘，慢慢的往旁边走去。

一抬头，就看见齐瀚和齐煜十分有眼色力的，已经在旁边的小摊位上坐下了。
樱落心头觉得好笑，端着托盘慢慢的向二人走去，将甜羹轻轻地放在摊位上的小桌子上。
“两位公子，快尝尝吧，刚买回来的。老伯伯人特别好，还送了我一份水果。”
然而齐瀚和齐煜却愣愣的看着，他们各自面前的那一碗甜羹。
齐瀚犹犹豫豫的拿起调羹，轻轻搅了搅碗里的糖水，但还是下不了决心似的，又放下勺子，迟疑的问道：
“这……这真的是能吃的吗？”
毕竟这东西看着不怎么样，而且还是路边……
“当然了，平民百姓们都爱喝甜羹！反正我已经买了，你们不喝也得喝，不然可就要浪费几文钱了，尝尝嘛，味道真的不错。”
樱落又继续蛊惑这两人。
齐煜觉得尝尝也无妨，反正在他眼皮子底下，樱落也不敢下毒。
于是他将勺子送进了嘴里，糖水绕着舌头转了一圈，滑进了他的喉咙里，竟是丝丝缕缕的甜味，不可思议的闯进他的心头。
“嗯，依弟弟看，大哥可以尝尝，甜羹味道的确很好。”
齐煜拍了拍齐瀚的肩膀。
在樱落和齐煜的怂恿下，齐瀚这才勉勉强强地尝了一口，但是他不觉得很好吃，只觉得是普通的甜味。
就在两位从没有体验过民间百态的皇子，犹豫着品尝甜羹的时候，樱落已经将自己的那一份解决掉了。
她见两位对面前的甜羹好像并没有太大的兴致，于是一伸手，将齐煜的那一碗抢到面前来喝了一口，毫不避讳他的身份。
齐煜眼眉撩起，黑曜石般的眼睛睁得大大的，惊讶的望着樱落，心头也噗噗的跳了起来。
一种异样的感觉从他心底升起，星眸微转，触动万分。
这还是第一次有人同自己喝同一碗羹……
从小到大，从来没有人和他喝过同一碗东西，就连母妃也没有过。

齐煜有些不太明白心中的这种情绪，是一种亲近的感觉，这种本能的亲近感让他觉得很可怕。
content_en:
As they walked, a loud shouting sound in the market pulled Yingluo into her past thoughts.
"Selling sweet soup, selling sweet soup, freshly cooked sweet soup..."
The tips of Yingluo's ears were far away, and she heard the old man selling sweet soup shouting.
Yingluo in her previous life loved this sweet soup the most.
Every time, the emperor would accompany her to the folk market in casual clothes, buy sweet soup, and make Yingluo happy.
But things have changed now, and Qi Han is no longer the same person as before, and he no longer remembers these things...
Yingluo lowered her eyes, feeling a little disappointed.
However, she quickly calmed down and pulled the two somewhat "out of place" men beside her.
"Hey, there's a sweet soup shop over there. Come on, gentlemen, let's buy a few bowls to try. It must be very sweet and delicious."
"How do you know this must be delicious?" Qi Yu retorted habitually.
However, Yingluo didn't care about him and just walked forward on her own.
"Young master, I don't understand. Generally, the taste of these small shops on the street is worse than that of ordinary shops, and the ingredients are sufficient. Let's go, go and have a look. We are just hanging out anyway, so why not try the food that the common people eat? Are the two young masters lying when they say they are aware of people's sentiments?"
Qi Han laughed and said, "Of course not. Ying'er is very eloquent and all these things make sense. Since we are here to understand the sentiments of the people, why not just hang out and take a look."
So, the two of them followed Yingluo's cheerful pace and rushed to the old uncle's stall in a few steps.
Yingluo took the initiative to step forward and said, "Old uncle, please bring me three bowls of sweet soup!"
The old uncle smiled kindly and said, "Okay! It's only five cents. Seeing that there are so many of you drinking, how about I give you another piece of fruit?"
"Okay, thank you uncle!"
Yingluo smiled sweetly and thanked her.
After saying that, the old uncle raised his hand and gave Yingluo a tray, which was filled with three bowls of sweet soup, and fruits were placed one after another.
Yingluo picked up the tray and walked slowly to the side.
When he looked up, he saw Qi Han and Qi Yu, who were very discerning, already sitting down at the small stall next to them.
Yingluo felt funny in her heart, and slowly walked towards the two of them with the tray, and gently placed the sweet soup on the small table on the stall.
"You two gentlemen, please try it quickly. I just bought it. The old uncle is very kind and even gave me a piece of fruit."
However, Qi Han and Qi Yu stared blankly at the bowl of sweet soup in front of them.
Qi Han hesitantly picked up the spoon and gently stirred the sugar water in the bowl, but as if he still couldn't make up his mind, he put down the spoon again and asked hesitantly:
"This...is this really edible?"
After all, this thing doesn't look very good, and it's still on the roadside...
"Of course, ordinary people love to drink sweet soup! Anyway, I have already bought it. If you don't want to drink it, you have to drink it, otherwise you will waste a few pennies. Try it, it tastes really good."
Ying Luo continued to bewitch these two people.
Qi Yu thought there was no harm in giving it a try. Ying Luo didn't dare to poison her under his nose anyway.
So he put the spoon into his mouth, and the sugar water circled around his tongue and slid into his throat. It was filled with strands of sweetness, which inexplicably entered his heart.
"Well, in my opinion, eldest brother can try it. The sweet soup tastes really good."
Qi Yu patted Qi Han on the shoulder.
Under the encouragement of Yingluo and Qi Yu, Qi Han reluctantly took a bite, but he didn't think it was very delicious, he just thought it was an ordinary sweet taste.
Just when the two princes, who had never experienced folk customs, hesitated to taste the sweet soup, Yingluo had already finished her share.
Seeing that the two of them didn't seem to be very interested in the sweet soup in front of them, she reached out and grabbed Qi Yu's bowl in front of her and took a sip, without hiding his identity.
Qi Yu raised his eyebrows, opened his obsidian eyes wide, and looked at Yingluo in surprise.My heart also jumped.
A strange feeling arose from the bottom of his heart, and his starry eyes turned slightly, deeply touched.
This is the first time someone drinks from the same bowl as me...
Ever since he was a child, no one had ever drank from the same bowl as him, not even his mother and concubine.
Qi Yu didn't quite understand the emotion in his heart. It was a feeling of closeness. This instinctive closeness made him feel terrible.
